## Projects (all live and open source)

- [TaskFlow](https://taskflow-web-rosy.vercel.app/) — task manager; JWT auth (bcrypt, 7-day expiry); role-based access control enforced in the service layer (admin/member); Node.js + Express 5 + PostgreSQL; React 19 + TypeScript; 44 tests run on every push; source: https://github.com/0535MANIDEEP/taskflow
- [DocVault](https://docvault-blond-rho.vercel.app/) — document system; single permission matrix (`viewer`, `reviewer`, `admin` × `doc:read`, `doc:upload`, `doc:review` + others) enforced on both the UI (`<RoleGate>`) and the API routes; Next.js; 15 tests on every push; source: https://github.com/0535MANIDEEP/docvault
- [SS Mart, Shankarpally](https://0535manideep.github.io/ss-mart-shankarpally/) — production website for a real supermarket; no framework, no build step
